title: Manager cards: date and weather, BTC, USDT to toman, gold
notes: A row of four read-only cards at the top of the manager page: Persian and Gregorian date with today's weather, then BTC/USD, USDT/toman and gold/USD with day, week, month and year change.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #68: four read-only cards on top of the manager page (date + Open-Meteo weather for the settings place, BTC and PAXG gold via CoinGecko, USDT/toman via Wallex), read every 30 minutes. Not yet seen on screen.
Merged in PR #68 as 1.9.0 after two review rounds; one low history thread (commit bf35dbb builds only with c868c2f) left open by choice.
